hero.title: Agents forced
hero.lede: Models already know shell workflows. Dekopon runs them in a controlled runtime on your hardware, with explicit access to services—not a host shell.

visual.caption: GitHub receives the broker-injected token; the script and Wasm guest do not. Trust the allowed endpoint: it can reflect what it receives.

useCases.title: Shell workflows, without a host shell.
useCases.intro: Compose structured data with builtins, then call installed providers for specific jobs. These command words are not the host’s executables.

closing.title: Run it on your hardware.
closing.body: Start with the broker probe, then connect a chat service and model. Dekopon is pre-production software.

protocols.title: Your agent, in your chat.
protocols.intro: Slack leads with its native Agent experience. The same runtime also connects to Discord, WhatsApp, and Telegram.
protocols.note: History is configurable and held in memory. Image understanding needs a compatible model; generated PNG replies require an enabled provider route.
